column1: # The pictures `just render` draws from reactor.scad: name, view, flags, tab-separated.
# view   the camera's rotation, as the GUI's Edit > Copy Viewport Rotation gives it.
# flags  -D settings from reactor.scad's Customizer: show (assembly, section, lid), culture_ml,
#        pocket_depth_set, riser_l_set; and any other OpenSCAD option. section removes the -y half,
#        so a front view sees the cut. It renders with Manifold, about a minute: a preview draws
#        every part's cut face in the last part's colour.
